content_sections.heading: About IISER Bhopal Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Bhopal for a time-bound research project under the CSIR funded ASPIRE scheme. The selected Junior Research Fellow will work in the Department of Chemical Engineering on biomass-derived carbon-based gas diffusion layers for PEM fuel cells and electrolyzers. The appointment is purely on a contractual basis for an initial tenure of 3 months within a total project tenure of 24 months.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must fulfil the essential educational qualifications, age limits, and testing requirements specified in the official notification. Essential Qualification: B.S. 4 years programme / Integrated BS-MS / MSc / BE / BTech or equivalent degree (in Chemical Engineering / Chemistry / allied areas), with 55% marks and passing of NET/GATE test. Age Limit: JRF-28 Yrs. Age Relaxation: The upper age limit is relaxable up to 5 years in the case of candidates belonging to scheduled castes/tribes/OBC, women and physically handicapped candidates.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Junior Research Fellow (JRF) receives a fellowship of Rs. 37,000/- per month. The project tenure is 24 months, and the initial tenure of the position offered is 3 months.

content_sections.heading: IISER Bhopal Junior Research Fellow Job Description
content_sections.text: The selected candidate will be expected to fulfil the following duties and responsibilities: The candidate should have knowledge/experience in Electrochemistry/Electrochemical engineering, Electrochemical Sensors, Material synthesis, particularly electrocatalysts for Fuel Cells and energy conversion applications. The candidate should have knowledge of different physical, chemical and functional characterization techniques. The candidate is desired to have an experience in different electrochemical characterization techniques pertaining to three-electrode systems and Fuel Cells via Potentiostats/Electrochemical Workstations. The candidate is also desired to be equipped with (i) scientific reporting and presentation skills (ii) coordinate with the team members and (iii) perform results analysis and interpretation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IISER Bhopal Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Prepare your application along with all required supporting documents as a single PDF file. Send the single PDF file via email to [email protected] on or before 31st October, 2026. Ensure the email uses the exact subject line: CSIR-JRF .

content_sections.heading: Documents Named in the Notice
content_sections.text: 10th marks sheet (DOB proof) Educational qualifications certificates (10th, 12th, Bachelors, Masters) Certificates (NET/GATE) Caste certificate, if any Photo ID (Aadhar/PAN card)

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The official notification specifies that applications are invited from interested and motivated candidates to be submitted via email by 31st October, 2026. Further specific stages of the selection process or interview schedule are not mentioned in the official notification.
